Class H3CellStateSnapshotHelper

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.database.H3CellStateSnapshotHelper
public final class H3CellStateSnapshotHelper extends Object
Stateless deep-snapshot cloner and Data-Oriented Design (DOD) component state projector for H3Cell.

Strictly projects conserved biophysical, geological, and demographic observables without synthetic state-level technology fields (AGENTS.md Section 10.1).

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
